track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 17: Leyli-o Majnun
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Leyli-o Majnun in Homayoun, Rast-Panjgah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gb3 and dwells most on A in Leyli-o Majnun. The line peaks at A4 (442.1 Hz) at 0:44.9. It closes on the tonic (A2 → Db4 → A3 → A3 → A3 → A4).

theory_fit.name: Vaziri 24-tone equal temperament
theory_fit.description: Quarter-tone grid (koron/sori = exactly 50 ¢ from the natural note).

theory_fit.name: Pythagorean / Safi al-Din
theory_fit.description: Nearest note of the 17-note gamut generated by pure fifths (±8) from the tonic.
